relationship_notes: Japanese boutique pedal builder established in 2019. The builder's surviving catalog now supports four central dirt models: monica overdrive, Lander fuzz, Stella distortion, and arca overdrive. CULT-limited Signe, arca CULT Limited, Lander CULT Limited iss.1/2/3, and monica AssH signature remain subordinate relationship records; Carla remains outside central dirt as a booster.
